name: pulse_period
description: Pulse-period meter: timer0 in capture mode counts clocks between rising edges on pin 0 (uio5); after each edge the lane reads the capture register and pushes it, low byte first, to the stream. Four periods per run.

word_notes.0-1: timer0 is never started; capture counts whether or not it runs
word_notes.4: pin 0 edge events on rise; no outputs enabled
